name: Exp_XCCI_Histogram_Vol
summary: This EA trades based on the XCCI Histogram with Volume confirmation, entering long positions when the CCI histogram crosses above zero with volume support and short positions when it crosses below zero with volume support. It uses a customizable CCI period and volume threshold to filter signals, applying fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels for trade management. The strategy is a momentum-based approach that seeks to capture trend initiation confirmed by increasing market participation.
summary_zh: 该EA基于XCCI直方图结合成交量确认进行交易，当CCI直方图上穿零轴且有成交量支撑时做多，下穿零轴时做空。它使用可自定义的CCI周期和成交量阈值来过滤信号，并采用固定止损和止盈水平进行交易管理。该策略是一种动量方法，旨在捕捉由市场参与度增加确认的趋势启动。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念基于XCCI（扩展商品通道指标）直方图的零轴穿越信号，并结合成交量确认来过滤假突破。入场条件为：做多时CCI直方图从负值区域上穿零轴且当前成交量高于设定的成交量阈值；做空时则相反，CCI直方图从正值区域下穿零轴且成交量达标。出场条件依赖固定止损和止盈参数，未采用移动止损或追踪止损机制。仓位管理使用固定手数方式，未实现根据账户余额或波动率动态调整仓位大小的资金管理逻辑。策略的成交量过滤设计有助于减少在低流动性环境下的错误信号，但缺乏对多重时间框架的考量和对市场结构（如支撑阻力位）的识别，可能在震荡市中产生频繁的虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is based on the zero-line crossover signals of the XCCI (Extended Commodity Channel Index) histogram, combined with volume confirmation to filter out false breakouts. Entry conditions are: for long positions, the CCI histogram crosses above zero from negative territory and current volume exceeds a set volume threshold; for short positions, the reverse applies with the CCI histogram crossing below zero from positive territory with sufficient volume. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss and take-profit parameters, without employing trailing stops or any dynamic exit mechanism. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size approach, without implementing dynamic position sizing based on account equity or market volatility for money management. The volume filter design helps reduce false signals in low-liquidity environments, but the strategy lacks multi-timeframe analysis and market structure recognition (such as support and resistance levels), which may lead to frequent false signals in ranging markets.

parameters.name: Volume_Threshold
parameters.description: 成交量过滤阈值，低于此值不交易
parameters.description_en: Volume filter threshold; no trade below this value

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA unique ID to distinguish orders across instances

pros: 成交量确认机制有效过滤低流动性假信号，提高入场质量
固定止损止盈提供了明确的风险控制边界，防止单笔亏损过大
CCI直方图零轴穿越逻辑清晰易懂，参数简洁便于优化和回测
使用魔术编号管理订单，避免与其他EA冲突
pros_en: Volume confirmation mechanism effectively filters low-liquidity false signals, improving entry quality
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit provide clear risk control boundaries, preventing excessive single-trade losses
CCI histogram zero-line crossover logic is clear and easy to understand, with concise parameters facilitating optimization and backtesting
Magic number for order management avoids conflicts with other EAs
cons: 缺乏移动止损机制，盈利头寸可能在回撤中大幅缩水后才被止盈或止损出场
固定手数仓位管理未考虑账户规模和波动率，不同资金量下风险敞口不一致
在震荡区间中CCI频繁穿越零轴会产生大量虚假信号导致连续亏损
未做新K线检查，同一根K线内可能重复开仓
cons_en: Lacks trailing stop mechanism, profitable positions may significantly erode before being closed by take-profit or stop-loss
Fixed lot position sizing does not account for account size and volatility, resulting in inconsistent risk exposure across different capital levels
In ranging markets, CCI frequently crosses zero generating numerous false signals leading to consecutive losses
No new bar check is implemented, potentially causing repeated entries within the same candle
improvements: 增加移动止损功能，在价格朝有利方向移动后自动收紧止损以锁定利润
实现基于ATR或账户余额百分比的动态仓位管理，使风险敞口随市场条件和资金规模自适应调整
增加多时间框架确认机制，如要求高周期趋势方向一致才允许入场，以减少震荡市假信号
improvements_en: Add trailing stop functionality to automatically tighten stops after price moves favorably, locking in profits
Implement dynamic position sizing based on ATR or account equity percentage to make risk exposure self-adjusting to market conditions and capital size
Add multi-timeframe confirmation, requiring higher timeframe trend alignment before entry, to reduce false signals in ranging markets

risk_points: 未实现新K线检查，同一根K线内可能重复开仓导致过度持仓风险
固定仓位管理未根据账户规模调整，小账户可能过度杠杆，大账户可能资金利用率不足
缺乏震荡市场识别和过滤机制，在横盘行情中可能产生大量连续亏损交易
risk_points_en: No new bar check implemented, potentially causing repeated entries within the same candle leading to over-exposure risk
Fixed position sizing does not adjust to account size, potentially over-leveraging small accounts or under-utilizing large accounts
Lacks ranging market identification and filtering, which may generate numerous consecutive losing trades in sideways markets
